dataset_example.question:
Let p(x) = det(x*I - A) be the characteristic polynomial of the 4x4 integer matrix
A =
    2   5   7   1
   -9   1   6  -9
   -4  -9   7  -9
    0   4  -1   9
numpy's np.poly(A) approximates its coefficients in floating point; your job is the EXACT integer coefficients. Return ONLY a JSON array of the 5 coefficients in descending powers of x, leading coefficient 1, e.g. [1, -3, 0, 12, -7].
